logline: Defying Alexander's desperate pleas, Juliana crawls barehanded into the razor-sharp blackthorn garden, enduring brutal lacerations under Clarissa and Gerald's cruel taunts until she unearths the lost emerald signet ring.

moments.description: Alexander desperately tries to stop Juliana from entering the deadly blackthorn garden.
moments.key_dialogue: Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this.

moments.description: Alexander vows he would rather face the gallows than watch Juliana hurt herself, while she expresses her absolute devotion.
moments.key_dialogue: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.

moments.description: Clarissa and Gerald mock Juliana from the terrace as she prepares to enter the terrifying briar thicket.
moments.key_dialogue: That garden has swallowed better women than you.

moments.description: Sharp blackthorn spines viciously shred Juliana's bare hands as Gerald and Clarissa cruelly taunt her from above.
moments.key_dialogue: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.

moments.description: Juliana's bloodied finger finally brushes against the lost antique emerald signet ring buried in the frozen dirt.
Juliana grips the blood-soaked emerald ring amidst blinding pain as Alexander watches in terror and the episode cuts to black.
